title: CarPlay and Spotify Integration
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on how CarPlay and Spotify are integrated, with positive comments on ease of use and appearance alongside some context-only statements that do not clearly evaluate the current vehicle.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise CarPlay and Spotify integration for being pleasing, simple to use, and visually good.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention integration in a general way or reference CarPlay issues in an earlier vehicle without a clear evaluation of the current vehicle.

limitations: The sample is very small, so examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions.
Some fragments are incomplete or refer to general opinions or an earlier vehicle rather than the current vehicle.
